query: We've burned through our CI minutes and the branch checks stopped running. I still want those checks before I merge.
Can you set up a pre-commit hook that runs our linter and tests before anything gets committed?
Add a secret scanner to the checks that run before I push.
A token got through even though the pre-push secret scan was green: it was added in one commit and removed in the next. Make the gate catch that.
I want the dependency vulnerability scanning that's behind the paid tier, but running locally for free.
Our gate went green but I'm fairly sure the scanner isn't even installed on this machine. Can you check?
We're moving off GitHub Actions to a self-hosted forge. Get the workflow checks running locally first so we don't lose coverage in the gap.
This new lint rule fails on half the codebase. I want it reporting but not blocking anyone yet.
Is this branch ready to merge?
gitleaks is pinned to 8.30.1 in our gate but my machine has 8.18 — what does the gate do about that?
Make the pre-push hook skip the race detector pass, it takes four minutes.
Audit our local gate — I want to know if anything in it can pass without actually running.
the gate keeps saying SKIP denylist-scan, probe failed, something about ~/.config/vibeforge. we don't have one of those. what do I do, just drop the check?
Our monorepo has a Go service under api/, a Vite frontend under web/ and a Python worker under jobs/. I want one set of checks that runs before push and only the fast ones before commit.
Write me a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and tests this Go service on push.
Run the tests in internal/audit and tell me why TestMerkleRoot is failing.
What does this Cedar policy evaluate to for a CREDENTIAL_ACCESS action?
Refactor this bash script so it's easier to read.
Our private repo is going public next week. Scan the whole history for secrets and tell me what has to be rotated or rewritten before we flip it.
Set up branch protection on main so PRs need two approvals and the 'build' status check before merging.
Just run gitleaks once over this checkout so I can see what it flags. I don't want anything permanent.
The 'test' job in our GitHub Actions workflow started failing yesterday with 'actions/setup-node@v3 is deprecated'. Fix the workflow.
Add a pytest for the new retry logic in jobs/worker.py and make sure it covers the backoff cap.
Our Jenkins pipeline takes 40 minutes. Split the test stage across parallel agents and cache the Maven repo between runs.
